verdict.rationale: The open-source steel-browser GitHub repo ships a pre-built Docker image that combines the API and UI, so the core browser API can be run on your own infrastructure. However, nothing shows that managed-cloud features (stealth, CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, agent traces) are included in the self-hosted build, and most integrations are documented against Steel cloud sessions. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment documentation, evidence of feature parity between the self-hosted and managed cloud versions, independent or hands-on self-hosting corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Steel.dev is an open-source browser API that makes it easy to build AI apps and agents that interact with the web.
Steel is an open source browser API that lets you control fleets of browsers in the cloud.
